# Eval Multi-Variable Array

![Eval Multi-Variable Array function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/formula-evaluation/05_Eval%20Multi-Variable%20Array%20VI.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Evaluates columns of a rank 2 array: X Values[variable,point]. Output is rank 1, one value per column, with no transpose. 10*x1+x2 on [[1,2,3],[4,5,6]] gives[14,25,36]. Fixed exact f64/Array signatures, without scalar lifting, broadcasting or implicit numeric conversion. Explicit FROG profile frog.studio.formula.evaluation@1 is distinct from the historical ODE dialect. Prepared payloads are validated versioned AST, never source to re-parse at evaluation or native pointers. NI connector documentation does not establish prepared binary compatibility or measured algorithm parity. Error in/out use the standard Error Cluster; incoming active errors are preserved.
